blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) on Tuesday warned motorists against scams posing as fake law enforcement agents and conducting illegitimate collections. Usually sent via text messages or online platforms, the fraudulent scheme, posing as traffic notices with suspicious links, directs victims to pay charges for their alleged traffic violations. “Do not be easily deceived by individuals who use the names of government agencies to demand money,” NCRPO Officer in Charge Brig. Gen. Christopher Abrahano said in a statement. “Report suspicious transactions and preserve messages, receipts, screenshots and other evidence that can help authorities identify and investigate […]...
